original_heading: Through Nature to Nature’s God, August 20
verse: And God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. Genesis 1:31.
title: God's Love Written in Flowers and Mountains
bullets: God speaks to us through nature, inviting us to see His character reflected in every beautiful thing He has made.
We are called to look through nature's beauty to worship the Creator Himself, not to worship the creation.
The mountains, hills, and flowers are God's gifts of love meant to draw our hearts closer to Him and assure us of His unchanging care.
prayer: Lord, help me see Your face in every flower, every tree, and every starlit sky. As I gaze upon Your creation, turn my heart from the beauty of things to the Beauty of You, that I might worship You with joy and thanksgiving.
